properties.name: Mamallapuram seafront & beach
properties.note: Low-lying sand behind the beach. Storm surge and wave run-up reach here first, and the only road out runs parallel to the shore.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — coastal band traced from the OSM coastline in the region bbox

properties.name: Mamallapuram old town & fort
properties.note: Dense low town centre with narrow lanes. Slow to drain and hard to route a vehicle through when water rises.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — built-up area traced from OSM landuse around the town centre

properties.name: Theewari & west settlement
properties.note: Very dense low-lying settlement west of the old town, with a large inland water body nearby. Evacuation on foot only.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — built-up area traced from OSM around the Theewari pilgrimage town

properties.name: Salavankuppam & backwater lowlands
properties.note: Backwater and paddy lowland south-west of town. Inundates early and drains slowly; treat all minor roads here as water-prone.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — traced from OSM water/backwater features south-west of Mamallapuram

properties.name: Seven Pagodas complex & hills
properties.note: Rocky elevated heritage site. Higher ground and open assembly space — the nearest refuge for people from Z1 to Z3.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — traced from OSM around the monument complex

properties.name: Kovalam coast
properties.note: Rocky coast with steep approach roads. The main access road is the single route in and out; blocked access strands visitors on the rocks.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — coastal band traced from the OSM coastline near Kovalam

properties.name: ECR corridor & Injambakkam
properties.note: Busy East Coast Road strip north of Mamallapuram. Heavy traffic becomes impassable when the carriageway floods; use parallel streets where possible.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — coastal corridor traced from the OSM coastline north of Mamallapuram

properties.name: Thiruvanmiyur coast
properties.note: Dense urban coastline at the northern end of the pilot region. Many low-lying stretches and a limited number of cross streets.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — coastal band traced from the OSM coastline near Thiruvanmiyur

properties.name: OMR inland corridor (Kelambakkam–Thiruporur)
properties.note: Elevated inland corridor with wider roads and more open ground. Usually a safer move than the coast when a flood warning covers the shore.
properties.source: hand-drawn, approximate — inland corridor traced from the OSM road network
